summary: Completed the provider-neutral control plane, aligned bootstrap paths, and made audit/index behavior safe for Windows and explicit repository roots.
Marked the setup document as reference material and identified the canonical repository implementation files.
Completed fresh-directory initialization for the PowerShell bootstrap path.
Excluded Python bytecode artifacts from the repository.
Transformed E.D.E.N-Protocol into canonical template with comprehensive docs suite, multi-agent universal forwarder trampolines, and robust cross-platform audit/indexer.

Review recs 1-5: init copies scripts/templates and never overwrites without --force; audit sees untracked dirs, adds --staged/--base/--verify, exact registry paths, append-only changelog coverage; AGENTS.md rewritten as lane-based decision rules; ASCII/no-BOM pointer files; no placeholder learnings; spec/template headings aligned. EDEN-SETUP.txt (logged 2026-10-23) was deleted in the TASK-02 commit.

Tool wiring and safe adoption: init --new/--adopt via scripts/eden-install.py with EDEN merge markers, --tools/--legacy, hook-config merge, command detection and .eden/verify; shared scripts/eden_common.py (more languages, E.D.E.N. files excluded); scripts/eden-hook.py stop hook for Cursor, Grok Build, Copilot, Antigravity (2 forced rounds max); .agents/skills; audit --doctor; docs; tests.
Stop hook audits every initialized root in multi-root workspaces (find_roots), not just the first; addresses Codex review P2 on PR #2. Test added.

Public-readiness: optional EDEN_SHA256 verification on init wrappers, tests for match/mismatch/checksums file; LICENSE, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, gitignore, path typo, and README Python 3.9+ docs. AGENTS.md Command placeholders kept so --new/--detect still work.
Added dogfood CI workflow .github/workflows/eden-audit.yml from docs/CLI_AND_AUDITING.md section 4.2 to run E.D.E.N. audit and verify on push and pull_request.
